authorization: Software and SITL only in ORCH-GZ-1. This protocol does not authorize purchases, wiring, charging, propulsion bench work or flight.
purpose: Replace explicit proxy assumptions and evaluate physical prediction on independent sessions; no physical fidelity qualification before these comparisons.

calibration_data.current: Five manufacturer MN4014KV330/15×5CF/22.2V points in calibration_proxy.json, exact propeller and ESC differ or unconfirmed.
calibration_data.future: Named calibration sessions with raw time series, equipment references, firmware/settings, temperature, SoC and sensor uncertainty; freeze fitted model and SHA before opening holdout sessions.

evaluation_data.current: Synthetic load profiles only in evaluation_campaign.json; no physical comparison available.
evaluation_data.future: Separate complete sessions, different from fitting sessions, including battery and propulsion holdout points/profiles. Never split correlated samples from one run between fitting and holdout. Preserve raw records and predeclare comparison thresholds.

preconditions: Inventory exact motor, Gemfan propeller marking/diameter/pitch/mass and hub, Tekko hardware/firmware/protocol, pack lot/age/cycles, BMS revision/thresholds, connector/PM08/PDB/CA01 and wire inclusions.
Reconcile total installed mass and CG; unknown mass is not zero; select BOM leaf versus parent mass exactly once.
Set acceptance errors, repeat count, thermal/electrical limits, budget and safe stop from approved component limits before any physical execution.
Follow DOC-VAL progression: unit/contracts, deterministic simulation, PX4 SITL/faults, then independently authorized secure bench and flight.

protocols.input: Exact MN4014KV330/Gemfan1555/Tekko32 combination with recorded firmware, voltage, ambient/air density and controlled secure bench.
protocols.measure: Timestamped thrust, reaction torque, RPM, DC voltage/current upstream ESC, temperatures, command and step response. Include known low/mid/high SoC-equivalent voltages and mission thrust region, both CW/CCW.
protocols.calibrate: Thrust/RPM and torque/RPM coefficients, DC power map versus RPM/voltage, ESC/motor transients; do not reapply motor/ESC efficiency to measured DC input.
protocols.evaluate: Independent sessions and load steps with model SHA fixed; compare thrust/current/power/RPM and settling time. Acceptance errors null until approved.
protocols.stop: Approved current, RPM, vibration, temperature or fixture limits; loss of telemetry; secure power removal through approved bench procedure.

protocols.measure: Pack capacity/Wh at mission-like current and temperature; rested OCV versus charge state, current pulses and loaded voltage, cell voltages, BMS readings and delays. Measure BMS/connector/PM08/PDB/wires separately to partition path I²R.
protocols.calibrate: Capacity derating versus current/temperature/age; OCV and R or RC battery fit. Nominal20Ah/444Wh is not usable mission energy. No manufacturer discharge rating is used as programmed BMS threshold.
protocols.evaluate: Separate mission-shaped discharge profiles and sessions; compare integrated Ah/Wh, loaded voltage, reserve timing and protection transitions. No discharge/recharge undertaken in this software lot.
protocols.stop: Approved OEM cell voltage, current and temperature or imbalance limits; BMS fault; observation failure.

protocols.measure: Simultaneous battery input and rail output power with real Jetson workload/SSD recording/fan, Airy, camera USB trigger, Pixhawk/GNSS/radio/sync/BMS. Record idle, boot, acquisition, compute and peaks at temperature.
protocols.accounting: Assign every load to one power branch. Basler through USB belongs once to its supplying rail. POWER1/POWER2 are feeds to the same avionics, not two full consumers. Convert per-rail useful power with measured efficiency once; losses common upstream belong to Rpath or measured aggregate, never both.
protocols.evaluate: Holdout acquisition workload and start/stop sessions; compare total battery DC energy and branch conservation.

protocols.measure: Complete aircraft and component mass, installed CG under known support reactions, rotor positions and axes, inertia pendulum or independent geometry/density comparison. Preserve exact configuration and units.
protocols.calibrate: Component mass/CG/inertia with inclusion graph and uncertainty; unknown density or effective material fraction remains explicit.
protocols.evaluate: Complete installed mass/CG held out from component fit; evaluate inertia with independent method.

future_gazebo_observer_contract.implementation: EnergyModel.hpp/.cpp observeRotors(config, previous_state, measured_rpm[4], dt_s); pure C++17, unit-tested, no network or flight commands.
future_gazebo_observer_contract.input: Gazebo PostUpdate observed joint angular velocities converted by jointVelocityToRpm: abs(omega_joint_rad_per_s)×rotorVelocitySlowdownSim×60/(2π). Current preview SDF slowdown=10, so restore factor10 before physical RPM input. Bind the actual SDF parameter, never assume displayed joint speed is physical rotor speed. Four separately identified rotors; simulation monotonic dt only; reject nonfinite, negative physicalRPM, missing rotors and out-of-curve RPM.
future_gazebo_observer_contract.output: DC propulsion power from reference RPM table, auxiliary DC power, Thevenin loaded voltage/current, integrated SoC/Ah/Wh and stop request. Proxy fitted to different propeller/unknown ESC remains unvalidated.
future_gazebo_observer_contract.adapter_status: Not installed or executed against Gazebo. No PX4 battery injection implemented.
future_gazebo_observer_contract.px4_source_gate: Before coupled endurance: pin exact PX4 commit; prove active battery_status instance/source with telemetry, disable forfait simulated_battery only in SITL, inject one modeled source through supported interface, verify freshness/identity and reserve/failsafe/landing/disarm. External BATTERY_STATUS acceptance and parameters must be checked against pinned MavlinkReceiver, not assumed.

measurement_evidence: Use T0 run_request/t0_run_manifest/t0_metrics/artifacts/events with config+binary+raw SHA, units and frames, fitting/holdout identities, exact stop/finalization reason and independent schema+semantic validation. Preserve material data outside Git.
